current_plate.title: Mount Sarmiento, from Warp Bay (Patagonian Andes)
current_plate.artist: After Conrad Martens; engraved by Thomas Landseer, Narrative of the Beagle
current_plate.verdict: Illustration, not a photo. But region-INACCURATE: Mount Sarmiento is in Tierra del Fuego, ~1,600 km south of Bariloche, not the Nahuel Huapi lake district. Monochrome. Worth replacing with a Nahuel-Huapi-type lake-and-cordillera scene.

sourcing_note: No public-domain ILLUSTRATED vista of Nahuel Huapi / Bariloche itself was found (only modern photographs). Per rule section 1, these are the closest region-accurate illustrated Andean lake-and-snowpeak vistas (same cordillera / biome). True locations are noted so the fit can be judged.

candidates.title: Lake of Acoleo (Laguna de Aculeo), Chile
candidates.fit: Watercolour of an Andean lake ringed by mountains; the closest lake-and-cordillera composition to Nahuel Huapi. Real location: Laguna de Aculeo, central Chile.

candidates.title: Vista del volcan Antuco
candidates.collection: Museo Municipal de Bellas Artes de Valparaiso, via Wikimedia Commons
candidates.fit: Alpenglow on the snowy Volcan Antuco over a rugged Andean foreground; the strongest, most atmospheric snow-peak vista. Real location: Biobio, southern Chilean Andes.

candidates.title: Two Leagues from Santa Rosa de Los Andes (with the Andes and Aconcagua)
candidates.fit: Clean watercolour of the snowy cordillera (Aconcagua) across a wooded valley; a genuine Andean snow-range vista. Real location: central Andes.

candidates.title: Valle de Aconcagua
candidates.collection: Museo Municipal de Bellas Artes de Valparaiso, via Wikimedia Commons
candidates.fit: Snowy Andes range beyond a braided river valley; grand cordillera vista, though the foreground is arid (cacti) rather than Patagonian-lakeland green. Real location: central Andes.

recommendation: bariloche/fanshawe-laguna-aculeo.jpg (Fanshawe, Laguna de Aculeo) for closest lake-and-mountain composition to Nahuel Huapi; or bariloche/somerscales-volcan-antuco.jpg for the most striking colour snow-peak vista. Both are region-adjacent (Chilean Andes), not Bariloche itself - note when choosing.
